summary.zh-TW: 往下捲時，下一張卡片蓋上來，被蓋住的那張往後縮小、變暗，最後疊成一疊。往回捲會一張張掀開。
summary.en: As you scroll, each new card slides over the previous one, which shrinks back and darkens until they form a stack. Scroll back to peel them off one by one.

text.zh-TW: 每張卡片都用 CSS sticky 黏在畫面上方，後面的卡片自然會捲上來蓋住前面的。堆疊本身不需要 GSAP。
text.en: Each card sticks to the top with CSS sticky, so later cards naturally scroll over earlier ones. The stacking itself needs no GSAP.

text.zh-TW: 被蓋住的卡片什麼時候縮小？看「下一張」：從它出現在畫面底部，到它黏到定位，這段捲動裡慢慢縮小變暗。
text.en: When does a card shrink? Watch the next card: from when it appears at the bottom until it sticks in place, the current one gradually shrinks and darkens.

text.zh-TW: 每張卡片的黏貼位置往下錯開一點，疊起來時看得到後面卡片的上緣，比完全重疊更有層次。
text.en: Each card sticks slightly lower than the last, so the tops of earlier cards peek out — more depth than a perfect overlap.

text.zh-TW: 變暗用一層黑色蓋板改透明度，不用 filter: brightness，比較省效能，也不會影響文字的清晰度。
text.en: Darkening uses a black overlay’s opacity instead of filter: brightness — cheaper, and text stays crisp.
